article.title: Presumption on proof of protest.
article.content:
119Presumption on proof of protest.

Section 119  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 25 of the Act
Ina suit upon an instrument which has been dishonoured, the Court shall, on proof of the protest, presume the fact of dishonour, unless and until such fact is disproved.
